subject: lang-dy
title: LANG.DY.------RT.ALGN.
description: Diagram in R(AS)CM(I)-3 (Reality Aspect of Creative Music, Level One), on the page where Braxton argues that jazz journalism's two basic positions — '(1) bebop is no different from what already took place in western art music — which is to say, classical commentary is valid because this form is understood, and (2) the solidification of this form (bebop) implies a profound separation from the composite continuum of black creative music' — both positions are wrong, and were united only in their being wrong. (C)LANG-DY (language dynamics) is crossed with RT-ALGN (reality alignment): the question is what language-dynamics produces when crossed with reality-alignment in a culture where the defining/critical community itself routes through linguistic confusion. MT-INFO-DB (multi-informational degree basis) branches from the main line, and (R)DIFF branches from MT-INFO-DB. From (R)DIFF branch PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), which carries (P)INTR (the point of idea completion of interpretation), and PART (participation), which carries AF-DY (affinity dynamics). T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branches from the main line; RE-ST (restructuralism) branches from T-C-IMP, and CUL-AF-B (culture affinity basis) branches from RE-ST.
